result.paraphrase: Gigabyte GeForce GTX 1650 Super Windforce OC 4G graphics card with 4GB GDDR6, PCI Express 3.0, 1755MHz, and 12000MHz. Description: The WINDFORCE 2X cooling system uses two 90mm unique blade fans, alternate spinning fan design, a composite copper heat pipe with direct-touch GPU contact, and a 3D active fan to provide efficient heat dissipation. Alternate Spinning is GIGABYTE’s solution for reducing turbulent airflow between adjacent fans by having them rotate in opposite directions, improving airflow pressure. The unique blade fan design splits airflow at the triangular edge and channels it smoothly along the fan surface’s 3D stripe curve to boost airflow. The 3D Active Fan supports semi-passive cooling, keeping the fans off under low load or low-power gaming so the system can run in silence when idle or lightly used. The heat pipe’s pure copper shape maximizes direct contact with the GPU for better heat transfer, and it also covers the VRAM through a large metal plate contact to help keep it cool. The composite heat pipe combines thermal conductivity and phase transition to efficiently manage heat transfer between two solid interfaces, increasing cooling capacity. Ultra Cooling includes specially designed lower RDS(on) MOSFETs for lower switching resistance and faster charging and discharging at very low temperatures. Low Power Loss uses metal chokes that retain energy longer than common iron-core chokes at high frequency, reducing core energy loss and EMI interference. Longer Life uses lower ESR solid capacitors for better electronic conductivity, strong system performance, and extended lifespan. The protection back plate improves the card’s structure while also adding an aesthetic finish and full protection. Main features: powered by GeForce GTX 1650 SUPER, integrated 4GB GDDR6 with a 128-bit memory interface, WINDFORCE 2X cooling with alternate spinning fans, 90 mm unique blade fans, and a protection back plate.
